title: Red One Climbs Streaming Charts Again Two Years After Release
excerpt:
Dwayne Johnson's holiday action movie is gaining renewed seasonal attention.
Its Prime Video success contrasts with a disappointing theatrical run.
body_md:
The Christmas action film Red One, starring Dwayne Johnson, Chris Evans and J.K. Simmons, is attracting renewed streaming attention as the holiday season approaches. Directed by Jake Kasdan, it follows a North Pole security chief and a hacker trying to rescue a kidnapped Santa Claus.

The 2024 release reportedly cost around $250 million and earned about $185.6 million worldwide in theaters. Yet its subsequent Prime Video debut drew a reported 50 million viewers in four days, a platform record at the time.

The seasonal resurgence highlights how streaming can extend a film's commercial life beyond its box-office performance. The report does not provide a new exact viewership total for November 2026.
